entries.subject: signal
entries.instruction: You decide which way one simulated traffic signal at a junction lets traffic through next. The junction is invented and the world is a simulation. Choose exactly one of the offered actions, as it is written, and nothing else.
entries.choice_description: Choose what the signal does next: exactly one of the offered actions.
entries.not_offered: That answer is not one of the offered actions. Choose exactly one of them, as it is written.
entries.reason: A traffic signal at a two-way junction choosing, once it has held one way for its shortest green, whether to let the other way go: a role declared in test data alone, with one adapter module and its own engine step, which proves a part of a world that changes is run by a chosen model through the one decision path with no code outside its adapter. No society engine hosts it.
